mentions.h: Surrey County x/c Championships - Report by Colin Pearson
mentions.note: ran with after effects of flu

photos.c: Into the bell in the 1500m and they've shed the pacemaker, Stu' Paton (entry fee sponsored by Oliver Foote to set up a sub 4!) Mark Sinclair looks a picture of relaxation and goes on to a sixth successive win. The next three hung on for pb's - Olly, Frank Ward (behind Mark) and John Booth in his seasonal debut after injury!
